name: Shoulder flexion (forward raise)
description: One arm is raised forward and up with the elbow straight, then lowered. Demonstration configuration for software testing.
instructions: Stand side-on to the screen with the working arm nearest the camera.
Keeping your elbow straight, raise your arm forward and up.
Lower it back to your side in a controlled way.

camera.guidance: Turn so the working arm faces the camera; the forward raise must happen side-on to be measured.

messages.target_not_reached: Raise your arm a little higher.

form_rules.message: Keep your elbow fairly straight as you raise your arm.

setup: Stand side-on to the screen with the working arm nearest the camera.
Stand tall with your arm relaxed by your side, thumb pointing forward.

cues.move: Raise your straight arm forward and up toward the green line.
cues.back: Lower your arm slowly back to your side.

key_points: Raise the arm in front of you, not out to the side.
Keep your body still; avoid leaning back to lift higher.
guidance.tempo: About 2 seconds up and 2 seconds down.

clinical_review.note: Thresholds and dosage are illustrative values for software testing, not clinical targets.
